data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, the spiritual significance of the name Golnoush lies in its symbolism of divine guidance and enlightenment. It reflects the belief that every soul is created with a divine spark, an inner light, which illuminates the path towards God. Thus, the name Golnoush serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to seek knowledge, wisdom, and guidance from the Almighty Allah and, in doing so, lead a virtuous and purposeful life. Moreover, it also suggests the idea that just as light dispels darkness, a child with this name can bring hope, joy, and positivity in the lives of others, thus brightening the world around them.
